verdict.rationale: A live probe found GrowthBook serving an llms.txt at docs.growthbook.io that links to a consolidated LLM-oriented docs bundle (181–194 pages). Docs pages are also served as .md, and the official MCP server loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails), giving agents purpose-built guidance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt bundle effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
